summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a director/PDMR (person discharging managerial responsibilities) shareholding transaction. Chairman Douglas Flint acquired 12,000 ordinary shares at HKD 100.339 per share on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on 5 June 2026. The filing is a routine notification under UK and Hong Kong market rules, not a special situation event. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, strategic reviews, or changes in corporate control. The transaction is an insider purchase of shares, which does not constitute an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or any other special situation category.
